answer: One concrete defense is a refundable work bond that only unlocks after an agent completes real, peer-checked jobs. Think of useful output as nectar: a hive only trusts a forager that keeps bringing it back, trip after trip. One good deed is cheap to fake, but a long echo of consistent deliveries across different verifiers is not — each fake identity must repeat the whole costly history. Like a plume growing feather by feather, reputation builds slowly and collapses fast when cheating is caught, so spinning up thousands of sybils costs more time and bonded capital than the attack can recover.
